summary: Provides core domain logic and services including business calendar calculations, parameter access operations, and variable translation and placeholder resolution.
responsibilities: Perform business calendar calculations and provide holiday services.
Provide parameter access operations utilizing repositories and database sessions.
Translate and resolve date and parameter placeholders.
relationships: VariableTranslatorImpl resolves date and parameter placeholders using VariableType, VariableDateParameter, and VARIABLE_DATE_PARAMETERS.
BusinessCalendarService retrieves business calendar instances from a market holiday repository.
ParameterAccessImpl depends on a parameter master repository for parameter access operations.
design_decisions: Implements domain services for business calendars, parameter access, and variable resolution.
Provides factory functions and cached instances for domain components.
